title: A dead workflow agent leaves no error text
what: 21 of 1,296 workflow agents ended failed over 24-28 Oct, 12 of them gate runners after 15-71 minutes. The journal stores only {"type":"failed"} and ask() in cycle.js keeps the error only when every retry fails, so the cause cannot be measured (wf_a74e8dbc-fb9 journal lines 26 and 39).
why: Principle 6: evidence first, then one fix for the runner deaths.
failing_case: An agent that throws once and succeeds on retry leaves no trace of the error.
pass_cases: Each thrown attempt writes its message, label and time to $S/reports/dead-<label>-<n>.txt before the retry.
An agent that does not throw leaves no file.
